description: Homelab repo. Extends Renovate to cover Argo CD Applications: helm chart versions in spec.sources[] (multi-source apps are invisible to the argocd manager, which only parses spec.source) and image pins inside helm.valuesObject (invisible to the docker manager). These deps are PR-only, never automerge.

customManagers.description: Argo CD Application helm chart targetRevision (both field orders; git sources without an adjacent chart: never match)
Image pins in helm valuesObject where repository + tag are pinned together
open-webui image tag (repository comes from chart defaults; only the tag is pinned in valuesObject)

packageRules.description: Helm chart bumps: PR for manual review only (values keys / templates / migrations can break an app)
Deps extracted from Argo Application manifests (chart versions + valuesObject image pins): PR for manual review only
